          SPECIFICATION
          
Technical Notes

          
Supports # and ## headings, **bold**, and - list-item snippets. Does not implement fenced code, links, complete list wrapping, or a full Markdown dialect. Output is shown as text and is not sanitized; review before using untrusted input in a website.

          
Frequently Asked Questions

          
Does it support all Markdown or sanitize HTML?
No. It is a deliberately limited snippet converter. Raw HTML is preserved in the output text. Review untrusted input before copying it into a CMS or rendering it.
